pages.text: Origins is the framework behind IridescentCraft's class and race system.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$(/bold) Origins provides the selection UI and the power system. All class and race abilities are implemented as Origins powers in the iridescent_classes and iridescent_races datapacks.$(br2)$(bold)Selection:$(/bold) You are prompted to select Race and Class when first joining a world. If you miss it, open the Origins menu (default key: $(bold)O$(/bold)).

$(bold)Limitations to know:$(/bold) Origins powers are applied on equip/select. If you change server settings or add mods mid-play, Origins may need a reset. Use /origin set command if your class/race appears broken.$(br2)$(bold)Race is permanent.$(/bold) Class respec uses the Class Altar.
